task_name: Find a user by first name and last name
description: Search for an Okta user by first name and last name and return the user's ID.
command: --data-urlencode "search=profile.firstName eq \"${answer1}\" and profile.lastName eq \"${answer2}\"" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; text=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(text) if text.strip() else []; print(json.dumps({"id": data[0]["id"]} if isinstance(data, list) and data else {"error": "Not found"}))'
questions: What is the first name of the user to search for?*
What is the last name of the user to search for?*
